verdict.rationale: Modal markets Sandboxes as secure, isolated environments for untrusted code, and its docs describe them as 'secure containers' [modal-probe-2]. A 'VM Sandboxes Beta' section [modal-docs-11] suggests a VM-level option exists, but only as a beta and evidenced by a heading alone. The pack never documents the actual isolation technology (microVM, gVisor, or similar) behind the default container sandboxes. Network egress and ingress allowlists [modal-docs-31] add some boundary controls, but they are not a hard compute-isolation guarantee. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the isolation mechanism (microVM or equivalent), generally available rather than beta VM isolation, a security or threat-model write-up, and independent corroboration of the boundary.
